title: 🚨 YOU SAY YOU TRUST GOD…
paragraphs:
🚨 YOU SAY YOU TRUST GOD…
BUT WHY ARE YOU STILL IN CONTROL?
Let that sit for a second.

You pray.
You believe.
You show up at church.

But deep down…
you’re still anxious, still overthinking, still trying to figure everything out yourself.

That’s not peace.
That’s pressure.
And most believers never confront this.
“Why It’s Hard to Fully Trust God (And How to Grow)”
This isn’t another feel-good message.
This will expose the real reason your trust feels weak—even though your faith sounds strong.

Because the truth is…
you don’t struggle with trusting God by accident.

There are roots.
There are lies.
There are patterns keeping you stuck.
And this book goes straight to them.
🔥 INSIDE THIS BOOK, YOU’LL DISCOVER:

• Why control feels safer than surrender (and how it’s silently draining you)
• The hidden lies that are blocking your trust in God
• What to do when God feels silent or distant
• How to break free from anxiety and overthinking—biblically
• Simple daily practices that actually build real trust
• How to move from fear → peace → unshakable faith
⚖️ REALITY CHECK

Most people say they trust God…
but panic when life gets uncertain.

Few people actually surrender…
and walk in peace even without answers.

Most want clarity before obedience.
Few obey—and trust God with the outcome.

Most stay stuck in cycles.
Few break free and grow.
Which one are you?
🔒 THIS IS NOT FOR EVERYONE
This book is NOT public.

This is where serious believers go to grow.

Inside you’ll get:
• Daily teaching content
• Spiritual growth systems
• Real transformation—not hype
This is not casual Christianity.
This is a movement of believers who are DONE playing games with their faith.

If you’re tired of anxiety…
If you’re done trying to control everything…
If you’re ready to actually TRUST God—
Step into the kind of faith that doesn’t break under pressure.
